MOD: Jamal/Josh.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Sunday 2/22.** Blizzard night. Bopping first turn featuring two entire tables and a few bar seats; streets were dead; guests included a Baton Rouge bachelorette party, four Georgia college radio administrators, and a couple. Cara anticipated the Great Snowstorm of 2026; popcorn given to every table at the end. Comps $0. Door: blizzard began but a few made the trek: two 4-top reservations (bachelorette; college friends on a radio conference trip) and two 2-top walk-ins (a duo with cancelled flights, two friends who didn't want to cancel). Closed early at 8pm. No no-shows. (Report posted 11:39pm same night.)
